sde: dX=f(X)dt+B dW; f=(sigma(y-x), x(rho-z)-y, xy-beta z)
fpe: partial_t p + div(f p - D grad p)=0; D=0.5 B B^T
boundary: total reflecting/no-flux (f p-D grad p).n=0 on finite box
fluxes: upwind advection; symmetric interior penalty diffusion

positivity.method: constrained L2 projection of cell averages, then Zhang-Shu scaling
positivity.guarantee: global mass preserved; all DG1 vertex coefficients nonnegative; hence the trilinear polynomial is nonnegative throughout each affine axis-aligned hexahedron
positivity.scope: postprocessed state at every completed timestep; not the unlimited algebraic solution
